about: The authorization rows split along accepts-vs-refuses (#1972): a permissive interface (#1950) satisfies a 'permissive' row-side; a 'validation' row-side needs a real check, named here. Checks: invalid, expired, wrong-resource, scope. Only catalogue-bound sides are judged: a side the catalogue marks n/a carries no verdict here (LoadAuthSplit refuses one) — since #2619 honoured each row's not-implemented-by-choice note (#1950 decision), most authorization sides are n/a and the validation target moved to the #1975 /mcp resource-server work.

server.why: the #1975 bearer gate (PR #2711) accepts only the daemon's own configured token and refuses any other token with 401 on every route including /mcp (daemon.TestMCPRejectsUnauthenticatedWhenBearerSet); a shared-secret gate has no expiry, audience or scope to check, so 'invalid' is the only check it performs (task 14860)
